New: follow-up reviews, reviewers and approvals, and one-step finish in the pull request review window.

What's new

- Reviewers: the window's header lists every reviewer with Approved, Changes requested or Not yet, and the sidebar shows how many have approved.
- Follow-up reviews: after new commits, Re-review checks only the new commits and marks each comment you posted Fixed or Still open. Fixed threads get a Resolve button. A follow-up takes about a minute.
- One-step finish: Post N + Request changes, Post N + Approve and Approve with comments, each behind one confirm.
- A notification when a review or follow-up finishes; clicking it opens that pull request. The PRs chip in the notch shows how many are waiting for you. Turn it off with Review done in Setup.
- A comment card with a code fix can be posted as a suggested change. Blocking comments can also be added as Bitbucket tasks.
- Mine: your own pull requests, and Review a branch… to check a branch before you raise a pull request. These stay a private checklist; nothing is posted.
- Keyboard: ↑ and ↓ move between cards, A and S switch Add or Skip, ⌘↩ posts, ⌘R re-reviews, ⌘L focuses the chat. Shortcuts at the bottom of the window lists them.

Limits

- If Bitbucket does not recognise the suggested change, the fix shows as a plain code block in the comment.
- Posting, Approve, Request changes, Resolve and tasks need the Bitbucket API token with write access to pull requests (Setup → Pull requests).

Install or upgrade:

    brew install --cask ankeshshankar/tap/ai-notch
    brew upgrade --cask ai-notch

After upgrading, the app is signed ad hoc, so macOS forgets Microphone, Input Monitoring and Accessibility: remove AI Notch from each list in System Settings → Privacy & Security, add it again, then quit and reopen the app.

First open: the app is signed ad hoc and not notarized, so macOS blocks it once. Open AI Notch, then in System Settings → Privacy & Security click Open Anyway and confirm with your password. If Set Up then reports the helper is blocked, run the command it shows:

    xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/AINotch.app

Requires macOS 15 or later (dictation: macOS 26).
